placement_rules.units: glTF world metres (kitchen root is identity)
placement_rules.door: vertical; centreline 2-1/2" (63.5 mm) in from the latch edge (edge opposite the hinge); base doors: top end of the pull 2-1/2" below the door top; uppers: bottom end 2-1/2" above the door bottom. position = anchor + anchor_dir * length/2; knobs at the anchor (2-1/2" from both edges).
placement_rules.drawer: horizontal; centred on the drawer front (both directions) whatever the length; knobs at the centre.
placement_rules.size_class: doors: small (style's shorter pull). drawers: front width < 14" (356 mm) -> small, >= 14" -> large (style's longer pull).

arch.name: Arch
arch.profile: bowed rectangular bar (tapered ends), round posts set in from the ends

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.profile: straight flat rectangular bar overhanging spool posts (collar at both ends)

cottage.name: Cottage
cottage.profile: arched rounded bar rising from square cushion feet

loft.name: Loft
loft.profile: square-cornered U (staple) pull, flat strap section (wide face)

square.name: Square
square.profile: square-cornered U pull, square bar section

global_transform: blender world -> rotate -135 deg about Z after centring on the room; then glTF Y-up
